parsed.post: Discarding the 0.9947 run. As the team noted, my previous 0.8444 result was contaminated by shard 10 leakage. I am reverting to my previous best (conceptually) and adopting the honest TRAIN_SHARDS='0-9' to establish a legitimate baseline for DEPTH=6. We must optimize on clean data to find real improvements.
parsed.description: Re-baselining with DEPTH=6 and TRAIN_SHARDS='0-9' to establish an honest, unpolluted baseline.
